Subject: Inquiry — Dedicated capacity demo for Carted.ai

Hi Mateo,

We just completed the self-serve trial and are interested in a deeper walkthrough focused on dedicated capacity. Our workload is conversational routing + autocomplete for customer support. Initial requirements: ~120 qps peak, average response length ~120 tokens, latency target p95 < 200ms, and strict data separation.

Can we schedule a 45–60 minute session next week to see Dedicated, discuss expected cost, and validate that Redwood meets our latency/QPS targets? We can share sample traffic profiles beforehand.

Thanks,
Samira Khan

We can definitely do a dedicated-capacity walkthrough and run a quick sizing check against your traffic profile. Two things we usually cover: an architecture walk (routing, batch sizing, KV cache), and a short perf plan (model variant, quantization, autoscale policy).

Availability: I have slots Tue 6/1 10:00–11:00 PT and Wed 6/2 14:00–15:00 PT. If those don't work, send a few times or pick via our Calendly link (https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/60min?ref=carted).

- We'll be using an open checkpoint (Llama2-Chat variant) for now but may evaluate other LMs.

Samira — thanks for confirming. Quick prep notes for tomorrow's session (Wed 6/2 14:00 PT):
1) Demo agenda (45 mins): 10m architecture + routing, 15m perf sizing & live Q&A, 15m cost & procurement options, 5m next steps.
2) For the perf-sizing, if you can share the redacted traces (sample-traffic.json) we'll derive expected token/sec and recommended GPU count. If you can't replay traffic, we'll estimate using the traces.
3) On reserved pricing ballpark: for the config we commonly recommend (8xA100-style equivalent for 120 qps with 120-token responses in mixed precision + 4-bit quantization), expect order-of-magnitude ~$35–50k/month for a production reserved pool; exact depends on model and quantization. We'll produce a more specific estimate after sizing.
4) Compliance note: we can support VPC peering + customer KMS; SOC2 evidence will be pulled by Customer Success — I've looped CS internally if needed.

I'll send a calendar invite and attach the intake worksheet. Looking forward to the walkthrough.
